snippet.title: [VR/PC Giantess Game]【巨大娘】Shrink with a Succubus (SwaS) (v.0.13.0) Game Update
snippet.description:
Game Download Link (0.12.0)
https://m87124games.itch.io/swas
https://www.patreon.com/posts/shrink-with-swas-109420102
https://fantia.jp/m87124games

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In this update, two new leg-focused motions are introduced for the succubus when she crouches, along with minor enhancements to the game shaders and textures.

This update also includes bug fixes on game mechanics and minor improvements to hit detection.

The new motions are not included in the "Succubus' room" right now, they would be included in the next minor update.

The detailed information would be included in the patch notes.

Enjoy the game!
